protocol.freeStatus: Listing application reaches thank-you when advertising is answered No. Yes opens campaign timing and a budget starting under $3,000. Work email required; Gmail, Outlook and Yahoo are rejected. Category list includes Videos.

note.en: Typeform now loads. It asks for name, work email, product name, short and long descriptions, URL, category and logo. Answer No to advertising; that skips the paid campaign questions and ends the listing application. The plugin pauses on that question. Not submitted.
note.zh: 问卷现在可以打开。要姓名、工作邮箱、产品名、短描述、长描述、网址、分类和 Logo。广告问题必须答 No，才会跳过付费投放和预算题并结束收录申请。插件停在这一题，未投稿。

protocol.category: Software Publishers NAICS513210 for software products; exact match only

note.en: Per-product actual country required. Address and phone are optional in observed form. Step2 needs registration, terms and CAPTCHA; review only, no automatic credential entry.
note.zh: 使用每个产品的真实经营国家；本轮地址电话可选。第二步需注册、条款和验证码，默认暂停检查，不自动录入新密码。

note.en: Email magic link can land in Spam. Authenticated, own tools empty. Free listing about a month, but required product pricing has no Free Trial: RTFV stops. Prefer active Next over persistent Create; Next is draft. No false pricing or final submission.
note.zh: 邮箱magic link可能进垃圾邮件；已登录、本人工具清单为空。免费收录约一个月，但产品定价必填且无Free Trial，RTFV停止。优先Next而非始终显示的Create；Next只算草稿，不误填定价或最终投稿。

note.en: Five steps; icon and hero image required; Free plan launches after the paid queue (~7 days); Google sign-in
note.zh: 五步向导；图标和 Hero 图必传；Free 排在付费之后（约 7 天上线）；Google 登录

protocol.freeStatus: Authenticated submission page returns User not found; listing eligibility unverified

note.en: Email/password account and email verification completed. /tool/add returns404 User not found, even after reload; stop for website repair, no duplicate signup. Uses configured password for ordinary login.
note.zh: 邮箱账号及验证已完成；/tool/add刷新后仍404 User not found，需网站修复，不重复注册。普通登录仍读取配置密码自动提交。

note.en: Google sign-in; PNG icon under 256 KB; tags from its own list
note.zh: Google 登录；图标只收 256KB 以内的 PNG；标签只能用它列表里的词

note.en: Listing free; 3–5 business days. From My Apps click Submit new app (hard navigation can show stale auth gate). URL extraction → replace generated facts → logo/media<5MB/category review → optional socials → terms+email subscription → explicit receipt. Review-only pending full widget automation; credits/reviews/promotions separate.
note.zh: 免费收录，3–5工作日。从My Apps内点Submit new app，直接网址可能误报未登录。网址提取→恢复真实资料→检查Logo/小于5MB媒体/分类→社交可留空→条款及订阅→明确回执。复杂控件暂保留人工检查；不消费积分或购买评测推广。

sites.name: ToolScout
sites.success: /^(?:Your tool has been submitted for review\.?|Submission (?:received|successful)|Thank you for submitting)/i

protocol.queueText: A week or more; upper bound unknown (paid boost24–48h excluded)

note.en: Email code login → main info → optional launch quiz → Standard Free $0 → exact Free Trial → mandatory human visits to5 community tools. User skipped this step; no automated traffic or final submission. Review only; final receipt unverified.
note.zh: 邮箱验证码登录→基本资料→可跳过推广问卷→Standard Free $0→精确Free Trial→强制人工浏览5个社区工具。用户选择跳过；不自动互访，也未最终提交，保持人工检查。

protocol.freeStatus: Registered account is Pending User; final listing conditions unverified

note.en: User registered, signed in, but email unverified; resend requested once and no matching mail found, including Spam. First software-name Next did not advance. Wait for verification; configured password handles ordinary login.
note.zh: 用户已注册登录，但邮箱未验证；已请求一次重发，含垃圾邮件仍未找到确认信。投稿名称Next无进展，等待验证；普通登录读取配置密码。

protocol.freeStatus: Submission in review; no promotion package attached; paid promotions optional

note.en: Basic info → Continue draft → story and completed screenshot upload<=15MB → Continue draft → country/category/tags → Submit Now. Require Your submission is in. Stop on optional paid promotion page; no package or backlink required, queue unknown. Private edit URL omitted from receipts.
note.zh: 基本资料→Continue草稿→介绍及截图上传完成（≤15MB）→Continue草稿→国家/分类/标签→Submit Now。仅Your submission is in算回执；付费推广可跳过、无强制互链、排期未知；不导出私密编辑链接。

protocol.queueText: Usually1–2business days; may take longer with volume
protocol.reciprocal: Only optional RECIPROCAL/Verified status needs backlink; ordinary submission does not

note.en: Free ordinary listing; usually1–2 business days. URL/email required, title/description optional, category automatic. Submit accepts Terms/Privacy/Guidelines/Standards; reciprocal badge optional, not claimed. Require explicit receipt.
note.zh: 普通收录免费，通常1–2工作日；网址邮箱必填，分类留空自动分配。提交接受条款/隐私/投稿规范/社区标准；互链仅额外认证，不申领。必须有明确回执。

note.en: Free launch, no badge. Sign in, review the launch date and Free plan, then submit manually; dofollow links only for the top 3 free launches.
note.zh: 免费发布，不需徽章。登录后检查发布日期和 Free 方案，再手动提交；免费发布仅前三名获得 dofollow 链接。
